name: Viva Goals
description: Microsoft Viva Goals was an objectives and key results platform for aligning organizational goals, tracking progress, and connecting outcomes to work systems.
agentUseSummary: Microsoft retired Viva Goals on December 31, 2025 and states that the service and customer data are no longer accessible. Relay mounts no connection or tools for the retired product.

providerSetup.blocker: Microsoft retired Viva Goals on December 31, 2025. Microsoft states that users and customer data are no longer accessible after retirement and that no replacement Microsoft product is planned.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Viva Goals unavailable. Customers that exported data before retirement should migrate that archive to a supported OKR system; Relay must not request credentials or present a connection flow for the retired service.

evidence.supports: Microsoft documents that Viva Goals retired on December 31, 2025, stopped new feature investment, and recommended exporting data before retirement.
Microsoft states that Viva Goals and customer data are no longer accessible after December 31, 2025 and that Microsoft is not replacing the product.
Historical Microsoft documentation shows that Viva Goals integrations handled goal data and authentication tokens, surfaces Relay must not revive after retirement.
